tokens.title: Garden tokens
tokens.intro: Every color, text style, radius, shadow and motion token in the Word Garden design system, with English, Chinese and Vietnamese test strings. Visible only with the garden flag on.

notes.swatch: The swatch uses the CSS variable; the hex beside it is copied from the spec. If they look different, the token is wrong.
notes.overline: Label style with the overline class. English is uppercase with letter spacing; Chinese keeps normal case and no spacing.
notes.motion: Hover or focus the tiles to see each duration. With reduced motion on, bloom drops to a 150ms fade and ambient loops stop.
notes.safeArea: This page's frame is padded by the safe-area insets and is at least 100dvh tall. On a Face ID iPhone the tinted strips show the notch and home-indicator insets.
notes.widths: Each bar is one GARDEN_CONTENT_WIDTH tier: full width on iPhone, capped on iPad.
notes.fonts: DM Sans (body) with Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese letters DM Sans lacks, and Fraunces with the optical-size axis (display). All three are self-hosted woff2 files, the same ones the canvas references were rendered with.

public.metaTitle: Dygo · Learn English words and how to use them

hero.title: Learn a word. Use it right. Remember it for good.
hero.lead: Every word comes with real example sentences and a clear explanation in your language. Then Dygo brings it back right before you’d forget it. Just 5 minutes a day.
hero.languages: Available in English, Tiếng Việt and 简体中文

plant.bird: I’ll remind you before it slips your mind. Want to keep this one?
plant.unknown: We’ll grow “{word}” for you once you sign up.

pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.lead: Tap a card to see how Dygo helps.
pains.hint: Tap to see how Dygo helps

use.front: “I know what it means, but I can’t use it.”
use.back: Every word comes with real example sentences, synonyms and fill-in-the-blank practice.

forget.front: “I learn a word today and forget it by next week.”
forget.back: Dygo brings each word back right before you’d forget it.

language.back: Get meanings in Vietnamese or Chinese when you need them, and switch to English only when you’re ready.

habit.front: “I start strong, then give up after three days.”
habit.back: Just 5 minutes and three small missions a day. On busy days, the rain barrel protects your streak.

how.title: How your words grow
how.lead: Think of every word as a plant. Each time you review it and get it right, it grows, and Dygo waits a little longer before the next watering.

seed.name: Seed
seed.means: A new word you’ve just added.
seed.reviews: none yet. It’s waiting for you.
seed.grows: you study it for the first time.

sprout.name: Sprout
sprout.reviews: often, later that day or the next day.
sprout.grows: you get it right a couple of times.

flower.name: Flower
flower.reviews: every few days, then every week or two.
flower.grows: you keep getting it right as the gaps get longer.

fruiting.name: Fruiting
fruiting.reviews: just the odd one, weeks apart.
fruiting.grows: you keep getting it right. Most words get here after about four good reviews.

spread.title: Reviews spread out as a word grows
spread.text: Reviewing a word just before you’d forget it is what makes it stick, so your 5 minutes go on the words that need it most.

drop.title: A water drop means it’s due today
drop.text: Words with a drop need a review today. Dygo picks them for you, so there’s nothing to plan.

forgot.title: Forgot one? No problem.
forgot.text: It goes back to being a sprout and comes up a few more times until it sticks.

uses.title: What do you need English for?
uses.lead: Grow the words that matter to you.
uses.soonLine: Until then, start with your own words.

work.name: Work
work.line: Words for emails, meetings and talking to customers.

study.name: Study & IELTS
study.line: The IELTS Academic word list is ready to go.

travel.name: Travel
travel.line: Get around with confidence on your next trip.

daily.name: Daily life
daily.line: Everyday words for shopping, appointments and getting things done.

own.name: My own words
own.line: Save any word you come across, with your own meaning and example sentence.
own.lineAi: Add any word you meet. Dygo adds the meaning and examples.

watering.title: Daily watering
watering.text: Review the words that are due today. Say how well you remembered, and Dygo plans the next watering.

quizzes.title: Quizzes
quizzes.text: Choose the word, synonyms, fill in the blank, listen and spell. Missed words come back, never a red cross.

beds.title: Topic beds
beds.text: IELTS Academic collections and your own beds, with example sentences, pronunciation and synonyms.

missions.title: Missions and Golden Bloom
missions.text: Three small missions a day. Finish all three for a Golden Bloom; the rain barrel keeps your streak on busy days.

shared.title: Shared gardens
shared.text: Learn with a class or friends. See how the group is doing, never anyone’s private progress.

language.title: Your language
language.text: Meanings in Vietnamese or Chinese when you want them, English only when you don’t.

parents.title: A garden for kids, too
parents.lead: Children learn their first English words with pictures, sounds and Dygo the bird. Big buttons, short sessions, and prompts in Vietnamese and English.

points.pictures: Picture quizzes: tap the word you hear
points.faces: Two simple faces instead of ratings
points.stars: Bees and stars, never a red cross
points.account: Open your child’s garden from your own account

free.a: Yes. It’s free to start, and you don’t need a credit card.

who.a: Anyone who wants to learn English words and use them with confidence, whether for work, study, travel or everyday life.

english.q: Do I need to be good at English to start?
english.a: No. Dygo can explain words in Vietnamese or Chinese whenever you need it.

phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
phone.a: Yes. It works in your browser on iPhone, Android, iPad and computers, and you can add it to your home screen like an app.

time.q: How much time do I need?
time.a: About 5 minutes a day. Dygo shows you which words need watering today.

ownWords.q: Can I add my own words?
ownWords.a: Yes. Add any word to “My own words” and review it just like the others.

kids.q: Is there a version for children?
kids.a: A garden for kids is coming soon. For now, Dygo is designed for teens and adults.
